7.problem: A set of points \(P_i\) covers a polygon if for every point in the polygon, a line can be drawn inside the polygon to at least one \(P_i\). Points \(A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n\) in the plane form a 2007-gon, not necessarily convex. Find the minimum value of \(n\) such that for any such polygon, we can pick \(n\) points inside it that cover the polygon.
